title: Archery Duel
description: Duel a bot archer and be the first to hit 70 spinning and sliding targets in this free archery game you can play in your browser.
about:
Archery Duel is a head-to-head bow-and-arrow contest set in the 13th century. You and a bot archer face each other across the field, and a new formation of targets appears between you every round: crosses, rings, diamonds and squares, some standing still, some spinning, and on the hardest level rows that slide from side to side.

Each archer gets three arrows per round, and a single well-placed shot can pierce several targets in a row, so aiming along a line pays off. The first to reach 70 hits wins the match. Three difficulty levels change how quickly the bot takes aim, and a tally of your wins and the bot's is kept between sessions.

Originally created by Jorge Rubiano for js13kGames 2023 as Archery Master.
howToPlay: Pick Easy, Medium or Hard, then drag back from your bow and release to shoot in the opposite direction, like a slingshot. You have three arrows per round, and a new set of targets appears when all targets are down or both archers are out of arrows. Every target you hit scores a point, and the first archer to reach 70 points wins.

controls.action: Choose difficulty, exit or play again

tips: Line up shots through several targets at once, because one arrow keeps flying and can score multiple hits.
Spend your three arrows quickly, since the bot is racing you for the same targets.
On spinning formations, aim at the part of the ring that is about to move into your arrow's path.
Start on Easy to learn the slingshot aiming before facing the lightning-fast Hard bot.

faq.question: Is Archery Duel free to play?
faq.answer: Yes, Archery Duel is completely free and runs directly in your browser with nothing to install.

faq.question: Can I play Archery Duel on my phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes, you aim by dragging with your finger. The field fits any screen, and in landscape it turns sideways so you shoot from left to right.

faq.question: How is the Hard level different?
faq.answer: On Hard the bot aims and fires almost instantly, and sliding rows of targets show up more often.
